title: Corpus verdict line
description: One verifier's answer for one corpus member, printed as one JSON object per line by a verifier's corpus mode. A verifier that judges a corpus prints exactly one line per member of every corpus it was handed. Lines from several verifiers over the same corpora are compared member by member. packaging/agent_evidence_vectors/verdictlines.py checks lines against this schema and against the corpus manifests.

suite.description: The suite field of the corpus MANIFEST.json the member belongs to.

corpusDigest.description: The corpusDigest field of that MANIFEST.json, so a line names the exact corpus bytes it judged.

vector.description: The member id as the manifest lists it.

verdict.description: accept: the verifier accepts the member (valid, allow). reject: it refuses it (invalid, deny). not-applicable: the verifier does not implement this suite, never a pass. error: the verifier ran and could not answer.

reason.description: The verifier's reason code. Null only on an accept that carries no reason; required on every other verdict.

result.description: The suite's secondary normative token on an accepted member, where the suite defines one (the AEE result token).
